Stability of factor methods across random seeds

Source: R/fabia_ensemble.R
factor_stability.Rd

Fits the chosen methods once per seed and measures how similar the results are: for every pair of seeds the factors are matched one-to-one (Hungarian algorithm on the absolute correlation of loadings) and the matched correlations are averaged. A method whose result does not depend on the seed has stability 1. If the true factor scores are known (for example from simulate_multiomics()), the recovery of the true factors is reported for every seed as well.

Usage

factor_stability(
  X,
  methods = c("FABIA", "FABIA_ENS"),
  k = 5,
  seeds = 1:5,
  truth = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

X

Either a single numeric matrix (features x samples) or a named list of such matrices. All matrices must share the same sample names (column names).

methods

Character vector of method names to run, case-insensitive. Any subset of c("PCA", "MFA", "FABIA", "FABIA_ENS", "GFA", "MOFA", "SGCCA", "JIVE", "RABFA"); see list_factor_methods(). Defaults to c("FABIA", "MOFA", "GFA", "MFA").

k

Integer. Target number of latent factors (default 10).

seeds

Integer vector of seeds (at least two).

truth

Optional matrix of true factor scores (samples x factors).

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages (default TRUE).

...

Further arguments passed to run_factor_pipeline().

Value

A list of class factomics_stability with pairs (one row per method and pair of seeds), recovery (one row per method and seed, if truth is given), summary (per method) and fits (the results per seed).

Details

This is how plain FABIA and ensemble FABIA ("FABIA_ENS") can be compared: a single FABIA run depends on its starting values, the ensemble much less.

See also

plot_factor_stability()

Examples

# \donttest{
sim <- simulate_multiomics(n_samples = 40, seed = 1)
st <- factor_stability(sim$data, methods = c("PCA", "MFA"), k = 3,
                       seeds = 1:3, truth = sim$truth$Z, verbose = FALSE)
st$summary
#>   method mean_stability min_stability mean_recovery  sd_recovery
#> 1    PCA              1             1     0.8059550 0.000000e+00
#> 2    MFA              1             1     0.8046031 5.744449e-13
# }
